title: Mixed Event — The Warmth of a Guiding Hand — Episode3 A Serendipitous Reunion

meta.Event: The Warmth of a Guiding Hand
meta.Event Outline: With so much on their plate, it's getting harder for MORE MORE JUMP! to keep on top of their schedule. Shizuku suggests that Saito become the group's manager since she's proven her talents to them, but things are not so simple...

rows.Line: A few days later
Ryusuiso - Lobby

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
“Ryusuiso”...
I think we're in the right place.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's further into the mountains than I initially realized, but I'm really enjoying being surrounded by nature like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank goodness we managed to catch the last bus though. A few more seconds and we would've had to walk.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I'm so sorry! I feel awful about getting held up at the gates after forgetting where I put my ticket...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's okay since it was still in one of your pockets.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That happens to me from time to time as well... Why don't we check with each other where we're going to keep them on the way back?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's a great idea!
Thanks for offering, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wait, are we here already?!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh wow! So this is what a traditional inn is like! It's like a big Japanese-style mansion! This is so exciting!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, you guys are quick.
But we're just getting started!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right.
I'm sure our room is going to be just as lovely, so we'll...
se_walk_women_004_2

Ah, good evening!
Welcome to our little corner of these mountains.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Does she work here?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <For now, we may want to keep quiet.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Good evening!
We have a two-night reservation under the name “Momoi”. I apologize for coming to check in so late.
Ah, Ms. Momoi, we've been eagerly awaiting your arrival! I need to apologize for not coming out to greet you sooner.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: My name is Saito, and I am the proprietress of this establishment. I hope you ladies enjoy your stay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
We're really looking forward to the next three days!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Saito...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (That made me jump a little, even though it's a very common surname.)

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Now, we'll take care of the luggage, so please come right in and make yourselves at home.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line:
Ayaka!
Please come help with our guests' things!
Okay, be right there!
se_event_warmth_2023_001
se_event_warmth_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Good evening, and welcome to Ryusuiso!
I'll take care of the luggage, so please—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: W-Wait, Saito, what are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: M-Me? I could be asking you the same...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We're staying here to do a shoot nearby tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Coming to this area and back in one day was going to be difficult with everything scheduled, so we decided to find an inn to stay at.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: O-Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Um, could I ask you a question...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If the proprietress's name is also “Saito”... Does that mean this inn...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Yes.
It belongs to my family.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: This is one of the busiest times of year for us because of a famous festival that takes place nearby. I come back every year to help out.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line:
Oh, do you happen to be Ayaka's friends?
That's quite a coincidence considering how deep in the mountains we are...

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Would you mind if I asked how you all met? At university?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
No.
We, um...work together, sort of...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Remember what I told you the other day about how I've been helping an idol group run their events?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Ms. Momoi and her party are that group.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line:
Oh, I see!
Then you must be the idol she adores so much, Ms. Momoi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, this is the idol she absolutely adores!
Shizuku, you're up!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, umm... It's nice to meet you. My name is Shizuku Hinomori. It's been an incredible pleasure to work with Saito.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line:
Oh my!
Now that I'm getting a closer look, you really are an outstanding beauty! Otherworldly even!

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: I can see why Ayaka's so entranced by you. Beauty also runs in my family, but you're quite a sight to behold!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: M-Mom, stop. You're embarrassing me...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
I'm really sorry...
She doesn't really watch TV, so she isn't exactly up to date on which idols or personalities are in right now.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line:
I do need to apologize for that.
I just find it hard to sit in front of a television for extended periods of time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, that's okay. If anything, I think we all really appreciate how relaxed you're being around us. This way, we can be at ease too.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line:
Oh, you're too kind.
But I have to ask...

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: How have things been going between you ladies and Ayaka? I hope she hasn't been causing you any trouble.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: M-Mom, cut it out!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Trouble...?
No, actually... She's been a huuuge source of support for us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If anything, we've been the ones causing her a lot of trouble... We can't even begin to thank her for all the incredible advice she's given us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm not sure if we'd even be here right now if it weren't for her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
To us, she isn't just someone we work with...
She's an invaluable partner who's been helping us put events together.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Yes, I see.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: I've been so worried about how she's been doing after leaving home to go live and work in the city... But I feel so relieved after hearing what you all just said.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She has such a kind look on her face...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(She must love her daughter very much...
Hehe. What a wonderful family.)

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: If you all have that much to say, then Ayaka must be doing an excellent job.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Which means this inn will be in capable hands after she takes over.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After she takes over...?

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Hehe. After she graduates, Ayaka here says she's going to take over from me as the next proprietress of our inn.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: I know I dote on her quite a lot, but she's grown to become such a resourceful woman...

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: We're looking forward to the day she takes over since we as a family believe that she will help usher in a new era for this inn.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She's going to take over after she graduates...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Is this what she meant when she mentioned her family the other day?)

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm so sorry...
I didn't mean to keep you for so long after just arriving. I'm sure you're all very tired after your trip.

rows.Speaker: Proprietress
rows.Line: Ayaka, would you mind showing our guests to their room?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I'll carry your luggage. It's right this way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For now, let's go...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay...
